name: Frances Jimenez
life: “I still remember catching my reflection carrying mismatched boots.” On Sunday, near the downtown fountain, Frances keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I kept the wrong slipper as a joke until someone at the bus stop offered me its mate.
appearance: Frances has a center part and straight chestnut hair, an aquiline nose and a square chin, and a favorite piece of clothing, a mustard canvas overshirt. It usually goes with a replacement button a shade darker than the others. When somebody else has the floor, Frances grins on one side while the eyes stay serious.
personality: Frances loves a well-told anecdote and distrusts the neat ending. The parts Frances remembers are the interruptions, unfinished jobs and people who had to go back to work halfway through.
agenda: To reunite the pair found at different stops.
family: Alexei Zhang is Frances’s older cousin. Frances calls about good news first. Alexei is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *Three minutes at the bridge*, Alexei says, “I can start earlier if someone else receives the first delivery.”
connections: Alan Chapman. A right slipper found on the bus can join the spare shoes from a dancing troupe.

reactions.situation: A visitor offers shoes that are far too large
reactions.response: Frances offers to look for a usable pair before anyone is asked to walk in loose shoes.

reactions.situation: Somebody finds a lost wallet outside the bank
reactions.response: Frances keeps the documents out of view and lets the person claiming it identify it before hearing any details.
